directions: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on the development o f students' cross-cultural communication abilities. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
In today's globalized world, the development of students' cross-cultural communication abilities has become increasingly crucial. To begin with, enhancing cross-cultural communication skills can significantly broaden students' horizons. When students interact with people from different cultures, they are exposed to diverse ideas and perspectives. For example, through an international exchange program, students can learn about different educational systems and social norms.

In addition, these abilities can boost students' future career prospects. In many multinational companies, employees need to communicate with colleagues and clients from various cultural backgrounds. Students with good cross-cultural communication skills are more likely to stand out in the job market.

Furthermore, it promotes mutual understanding and respect among different cultures. When students communicate effectively across cultures, they can break down cultural barriers and reduce misunderstandings.

In conclusion, the development of students' cross-cultural communication abilities is of great significance. Universities should take more measures to provide students with opportunities to improve these skills, such as holding cultural festivals and international seminars.
